findings.title: Tide table is in UTC and the arrival time is not checked against the sill-gate window
findings.description: The plan-visit page asks for an arrival time from a plain list (06:00 to 21:00) and, below it, shows 'High water at the quay, times in UTC' with the rule 'the sill gate is open from about two hours before high water until two hours after'. The product formats times in local time, and on 17 October the UK is on BST (UTC+1). To pick a workable time the skipper must remember the HW time, add an hour and work out a plus or minus 2 h window, then hold that in mind while choosing from the list above the table.
